name: Boon of Spell Recall
summary: An epic boon that sometimes keeps a level 1–4 spell slot from being expended.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.text: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

benefits.name: Free Casting
benefits.text: Whenever you cast a spell with a level 1–4 spell slot, roll 1d4. If the number you roll is the same as the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.
